editor.title: Zones and lines · {{camera}}
editor.helpSelect: Select a zone or line to move or reshape it, or choose a drawing tool.
editor.helpSelected: Drag to move. Drag the white handles to reshape, click a small dot to add a point, double-click a handle to remove it. Press Delete to remove the shape.
editor.helpZone: Click to place the corners of the zone.
editor.helpZoneClose: Click the first point, double-click, or press Enter to close the zone. Esc cancels.
editor.helpLine: Click where the counting line starts.
editor.helpLineEnd: Click where the line ends. The arrow shows the "in" direction.
editor.noZones: No zones yet. Use Draw zone.
editor.noLines: No counting lines yet. Use Draw line.
editor.arrowHelp: People walking in the arrow's direction are counted as "in".
editor.saved: Saved. The edge box picks up the change within a minute.
editor.inUse: Cannot delete: {{detail}}. Change or remove that rule first.
editor.normalisedNote: Shapes are stored relative to the picture size, so they stay in place if the stream resolution changes.
